entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: There's no way I'd lose to an otaku![n]I don't lose 'cause I'm not an otaku!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: This guy's not making any sense...[n]Let's try to calm him down, Joker!

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: I won't lose to an otaku!

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: Hold on a sec! Why am I the one getting[n]hurt here!

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: Let's talk about it, seriously!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Hey Joker, maybe we're being too nice,[n]but I think we should try talking to him.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: So, here's the stuff we know about him.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: "He's got a friend at Akihabara,"[n]"He seemed most happy when he[n]was nerding out," and...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: "His parents got upset at him for[n]failing his entrance exam"...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: For some reason, I can't just leave[n]him behind.
By choosing the correct answers,[n]you will be able to change the[n]target's heart.
Use the information you[n]have obtained to respond[n]successfully!

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: All right, first of all... I want you guys[n]to understand that I'm not an otaku.
You're right.
You have a friend in Akiba.

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: Right!? See? I'm not doing anything[n]wrong!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Crap! Looks like we made it worse![n]It's prolly best if we chose what you[n]say wisely!

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: What friend...!?

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: I've got no friend in Akiba! Like I said,[n]I'm not an otaku!

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Even after he found out what you were[n]doing, he insisted that you weren't the[n]type who could do such a thing.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: If that isn't a friend, then what is?

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: He said that...?

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: But I...

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: Otakus need to learn their lesson.[n]That's why I did what I did.

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: 'Cause I don't wanna get hurt...
And your entrance exam?
You are in pain right now.

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: Sh-Shut up! It's not painful at all!

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: I can keep going!

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: Wha...

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: How the hell do you know about that!?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: We did some research on ya.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: You went through some rough times[n]after your parents found out about[n]your exams, didn't you?

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: Don't you think it's wrong to blame[n]that solely on your nerdy hobbies?

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: Just shut up! There's nothing fun about[n]being an otaku!
Not even getting to nerd out?
What about Maid Cafés?

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: Well...

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: There must've been a lotta things that[n]were fun when you were an otaku.

entries.speaker: Futaba
entries.en: C'mon, Joker. Tell him.
Your friend's waiting for you.
Don't betray your friend.

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: My... friends...?

entries.speaker: Shadow Oi
entries.en: You can't talk to him
